meaning:
A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.26.31;
son of: Gilead (H1568H);
brother of: Abiezer (H0044I), Helek (H2507), Asriel (H0844), Shemida (H8061) and Hepher (H2660A)
Also named: shikh.mi (שִׁכְמִי "Shechemite" H7930)
§ Shechem = "back" or "shoulder"
1) son of Gilead and grandson of Manasseh
2) a Manassite, son of Shemida

elsewhere.note: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;
So this was for the rest of the children of Manasseh according to their families: for the children of Abiezer, for the children of Helek, for the children of…
The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
